title: Action to edit app's .desktop file in the context menu
line: Task Manager entries now have "Edit Application…" under More, which opens the Menu Editor to change the app's name or icon.
explanation: The Task Manager context menu had no way to open an app's menu entry, so changing a pinned app's icon or name meant finding it in KMenuEdit by hand. Kickoff and Kicker already offer "Edit Application…". Open MR !4169 adds the same action to the Task Manager's More submenu for pinned launchers and running windows whose launcher resolves to an application with a menu entry, launching KMenuEdit on that entry; pinned launchers now get a More submenu holding only this action.

commits.message:
taskmanager: Add "Edit Application…" to the context menu

The Task Manager offers no way to change how an app appears on it.
Kickoff and Kicker already have "Edit Application…", which opens the
menu editor on that entry; add the same action to the "More" submenu
for any task whose launcher URL resolves to an application with a menu
entry, and hide it when the panel is system immutable.

Pinned launchers had no "More" submenu; it now appears for them when
the application can be edited, showing only this action, since the
window actions in it do not apply to launchers.

BUG: 369167

media.caption: Pinned Dolphin launcher on master: no More submenu, no way to edit the app
With !4169: More → Edit Application… on the pinned launcher
Running Dolphin window on master: More has only window actions
With !4169: Edit Application… at the end of More, after a separator
Clicking it opens the Menu Editor with Dolphin selected
After changing the name and icon in the Menu Editor and saving, the pinned launcher updates at once
